referenceSources.title: Lot 78 - 1992 Alfa Romeo 33 16v Permanent 4 wheel
referenceSources.description:
A striking red 1992 Alfa Romeo 33 16v Permanent 4 wheel drive hatchback, registration K451 POY, stands on a mix of grass and interlocking paving. Fitted with O.Z. Racing alloy wheels and Recaro racing seats, this rare Italian model also features a factory sunroof, electric front windows, heated rear screen, and headlight washers. The car has covered 60,033 miles, carries a manual transmission, and held a valid MOT until May 2022.

Offered as Lot 78 by Manor Park Classics in July 2021, this example sold for £7,015 inclusive of buyer’s premium and VAT. It is the only Alfa Romeo 33 16v 4x4 currently registered with the DVLA. Recent maintenance includes cambelt and auxiliary belt replacement, new water pump, radiator, starter motor, brake pads, discs, clutch, and slave cylinder. The sale included the original alloy wheels, a spare wheel, and a collection of spares in the boot.
